subject: Ally alignment: MAP checklist, EB agenda draft & boardroom lock request
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@acme.corp>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@acme.corp>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Ally alignment: MAP checklist, EB agenda draft & boardroom lock request

Hi Olivia —

Great to be reconfirming timing after last week’s demo. I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft EB agenda for the boardroom session you asked about. High-level asks below:

- Can you confirm the exec sponsor(s) who will lead the EB conversation? We typically need a primary sponsor (C-level) + a technical sponsor from the platform side.
- Which week in the window Nov 29–Dec 3 is your preference for the boardroom? We need to lock the room and a SRC for our side.
- Procurement: can you share the preferred PO / contracting owner so we can surface the small SLA exception in advance?

Attached: RDW-Acme-MAP-v2.pdf (MAP with milestones and decision gates), EB-meeting-agenda-202711.xlsx (15/45/90 min agenda options).

If it helps, draft MAP milestones I’m proposing: discovery close (11/20), final eval signoff (11/27), EB & boardroom (week of 11/29), contract signature (12/8).

I’ll loop Marissa for sponsor coordination and Ben for renewal economics in the thread.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise GTM 
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW-Acme-MAP-v2.pdf (3 pages)]
[Attachment: EB-meeting-agenda-202711.xlsx]

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@acme.corp>

Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 11:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ally alignment: MAP checklist, EB agenda draft & boardroom lock request

Tessa —

Thanks for the materials. Quick answers:
- Exec sponsor: our CTO, Laila Chen, will be the primary exec sponsor; Samir (cc’d) will be technical sponsor and lead the evaluation.
- Preference: week of Nov 29 is fine; prefer Tue/Wed mornings for exec availability.
- Procurement: looping in procurement (procurement@acme.corp). Samir, can you confirm whether Acme requires a pre-signed SLA exception?

Also, a note on scope: the security checklist will need an addendum on data residency for the pilot — happy to flag that in the MAP.

Olivia
Head of Strategic Accounts
Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ally alignment: MAP checklist, EB agenda draft & boardroom lock request

All —

Quick internal thread before we send the next proposal back to Acme. Thoughts / asks:

1) Sponsor matrix — propose primary = Laila Chen (CTO), secondary = Samir Rao (Head of Platform). If Laila can do Tue AM (11/30) we should push for that.

2) EB agenda — Marissa (me) recommends 45-min exec slot: 10 min context, 15 min ROI/ops, 20 min Q&A + signoff ask. We should include a short live run of MLP latency/cost for 2 core use cases (search and summarization).

3) Contract / SLA exception — Ben, we need a recommendation on whether we can approve the one-off retention exception for a two-month pilot. If we pre-approve, procurement friction goes down.

4) MAP gating language — Karthik, can you add a gate that requires security review signoff before EB? Priyom, please attach the version with the optional on-prem path.

If we get Laila locked, I’ll draft the invite and ask for the boardroom (internal and Acme) to be held.

—Marissa
VP, Customer Success 
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ally alignment: MAP checklist, EB agenda draft & boardroom lock request

Marissa / team —

We can accept a temporary retention derogation for a two-month pilot under the following conditions:
- Pilot data segmented and tagged with pilot-id; no long-term storage beyond 60 days.
- Limited to non-regulated PII scopes defined in the MAP appendix.
- Escalation path & audit access to Acme security (read-only).

If Acme accepts those, finance will OK a one-time SLA exception and a 10% prepay credit in exchange for a firm signature by 12/08. I’ll prepare a succinct exception doc and attach to the DocuSign envelope.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations 
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLA-exception-request.pdf]

Thanks all — following up with a consolidated proposal and next steps.

1) Proposed EB time: Tuesday, Nov 30 / 09:30–10:15 PT (45-min exec slot). Please confirm if Laila can do that window.
2) MAP (attached v2) updated with gates: security signoff required pre-EB; legal review by 12/03; contract signature target 12/08.
3) SLA exception: Ben attached a one-page exception with the constraints. If Acme confirms, we’ll include it in the DocuSign envelope and route to procurement.

Action items for Acme:
- Olivia / Samir: confirm Laila and the Tue AM window OR propose Wed AM.
- Procurement: confirm preferred PO flow and whether DocuSign is acceptable.

If we have a green light by Tue EOD, Marissa will send the formal invite + runbook and I’ll open the DocuSign envelope (link below).
